title: Oliver & Chi's Saigon picks
sub: Oliver's food, drink and coffee tips (sent Apr 2023, rechecked Nov 2026)
tip: Oliver's rules: crossing the road, DON'T stop. Walk slow and steady; the bikes have already adjusted for where you'll be. Take it easy, Vietnam is exhausting. His tips are from 2023; all of these still had listings in 2026, but check hours before you go.

home.name: Wink Hotel Saigon Centre
home.addr: 75 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, Đa Kao, District 1

places.name: Quince Saigon
notes: "Best meal in Saigon. Sooooooo good. Not cheap."
Wood-fired Mediterranean; dinner from 5:30pm daily, last order ~9:45pm

places.name: Anan Saigon
notes: Inventive Vietnamese with Aussie touches, overlooking one of Saigon's oldest markets
Look out for the granny butcher picking her toes at the market opposite

places.name: Apothecary
notes: "Hidden away cute local one (not super but special)"
Old-clinic-themed cocktail bar behind a half-shut iron door; drinks named after scientists
Pin is approximate (it's in the lanes by Huỳnh Khương Ninh); Directions finds the address

places.name: The Workshop Coffee
notes: "Coffee. You can hang out with the cool hipsters there"
Upstairs specialty roastery in an old warehouse, ~8am–8:30pm

places.name: Social Club Rooftop
notes: Oliver's drinks pick: rooftop pool bar on the 24th floor of Hôtel des Arts

places.name: Spice Bistro & Hum Vegetarian
notes: "Awesome Vietnamese": two restaurants facing each other, Spice (normal) and Hum (vegetarian), sharing a garden
Pin is the middle of Thảo Điền, not the door; Directions finds 32 Đường số 11
